name: TLL OS Agent Registry
description: Registry of AI Agents and human contributors authorized to participate in TLL OS development. Agents must register here before submitting changes.

agents.description: Primary AI Agent for TLL OS bootstrap development. Responsible for compiler, vm, runtime, stdlib, blockchain, and AI Engineering Foundation implementation.
agents.verification_note: Identity verified by git commit author attribution and CI run logs. Ed25519 key pending P0-15.19 cryptographic foundation.
agents.permissions_note: Level 3: can commit core code, run tests, submit evidence. Cannot modify Truth or Protocol directly.

human_contributors.name: TLL OS Project Maintainer
human_contributors.description: Human maintainer with final authority on Truth changes, Protocol amendments, and project direction.

registration_policy.note: AI Agents must be registered before their commits are accepted by CI. Human contributors are verified by GitHub account.
